name: Project Mariner
notes: Historical product entry. The primary source is the Project Mariner section of Google's December 2024 Gemini 2.0 announcement, which describes an early research prototype tested by trusted testers. The Google Labs page at this URL states that Project Mariner was shut down on 4 May 2026, and the former deepmind.google Project Mariner pages redirect to the DeepMind home page.
summary: Discontinued Google browser-agent research prototype built with Gemini 2.0 that read screen pixels and page elements and acted in the active Chrome tab through an extension, asking before sensitive actions.
